verdict.rationale: Gladia is a speech-to-text and audio-intelligence API, not an agent or assistant host, so plugging external MCP servers in for it to use as tools is outside its product role. The evidence shows only an official Gladia MCP server (the server role), which does not make this client-side axis applicable. Nothing shows Gladia consuming third-party MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
